main.description: Revoke the authenticated aggregator's API key. After revocation, the aggregator must complete OAuth flow again to create a new API key. This action cannot be undone.

schema.description: No input required. Revokes the key for the authenticated aggregator.

revokedAt.description: ISO8601 timestamp when the key was revoked

errors.description: Authentication is required to revoke an API key
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

errors.description: Only registered aggregators can revoke API keys
errors.name: AggregatorRequired

errors.description: No API key exists to revoke
errors.name: ApiKeyNotFound

errors.description: API key has already been revoked
errors.name: ApiKeyAlreadyRevoked

errors.description: Failed to revoke the API key
errors.name: RevocationFailed
